question: Assume today is 2026-09-01. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate the total value of online shopping transactions in South Korea in August 2026, in Korean won (KRW), as it will be first reported in the national statistics agency's monthly Online Shopping Trends release (온라인쇼핑동향, National Data Office, formerly Statistics Korea).

target.what: Total value of online shopping transactions in South Korea during August 2026, as reported in the National Data Office (formerly Statistics Korea) monthly Online Shopping Trends (온라인쇼핑동향) release — i.e., the aggregate online shopping transaction amount (거래액) for the reference month, all commodities,
target.publisher: National Data Office (국가데이터처, formerly Statistics Korea / 통계청)
target.caveats: Target period is completed relative to the 2026-09-01 cutoff but the official August 2026 figure will not yet be published (typically released ~1 month after month-end, i.e., early October 2026), so the value must be estimated. Working interpretation: total online shopping transaction value (거래액) in

candidates.hypothesis: The target is a continuation of a monthly series; recent published months (through ~July 2026) plus the same-month prior years (Aug 2023, Aug 2024, Aug 2025) give level, trend, and August seasonal factor. Target ≈ latest level × trend growth × August seasonal index.
candidates.data_to_find: Monthly total online shopping transaction value (거래액) for all commodities, KRW, from Online Shopping Trends releases for 2023-01 through the latest month published before 2026-09-01 (ideally through 2026-07). Also the August values for 2023, 2024, 2025 to derive the August seasonal ratio. Minimum: last 12-24 monthly totals plus three August observations.
search_hints: Statistics Korea online shopping trends monthly transaction value 2025 2026

candidates.hypothesis: Online shopping is a large share of total retail sales; total retail sales value (or household consumption) × online share gives an independent level estimate. Target ≈ monthly retail sales × online-penetration share, adjusted for scope differences.
candidates.data_to_find: Monthly total retail sales value (소매판매액지수 or 소매판매액) for Korea, and the online share of retail sales (온라인 매출 비중) for recent months; ideally the ratio of online shopping transaction value to retail sales in overlapping periods to calibrate the bridge.
search_hints: online share of retail sales Korea 2025 2026

candidates.perspective: Mobile vs total split and category composition
candidates.hypothesis: Total online = mobile + PC (non-mobile). If mobile transaction value and mobile share are available, total can be reconstructed; category-level series (food, cosmetics, electronics, travel) can be summed as a cross-check.
candidates.data_to_find: Monthly mobile (모바일) online shopping transaction value and mobile share for 2025-2026; commodity-group breakdown (상품군별 거래액) for recent months. Minimum: mobile share and total for the latest published month.

candidates.hypothesis: Online purchases are settled through card/electronic payment rails; aggregate e-commerce card payment value (전자상거래 결제액 or 신용카드 온라인 결제) tracks the target closely. Target ≈ online card payment value × coverage adjustment.
candidates.data_to_find: Monthly credit/debit card online (e-commerce) payment value from Bank of Korea or card associations for 2025-2026; the ratio of online shopping transaction value to card e-commerce payments in overlapping months to calibrate.

candidates.hypothesis: August 2026 has no major Korean gift-giving holiday, but summer vacation/travel, heat waves, and any major platform promotions (e.g., 8.8/8.15 sales) shift the level. Quantify deviation of Aug 2026 from the seasonal norm using event/promotion signals.
candidates.data_to_find: Evidence of major online retail promotions or disruptions in August 2026 (major platform sale events, travel booking surge, weather-driven demand), and historical August deviations from trend to size the effect.

candidates.hypothesis: Published e-commerce market forecasts or monthly trackers (e.g., from research firms, ministry reports) provide an independent level or growth rate for 2026 that can anchor the estimate.
candidates.data_to_find: 2026 Korea e-commerce/online shopping market size forecasts or growth-rate projections published before 2026-09-01; any monthly tracker estimates for mid-2026.

Decomposition of the 2025 daily card total: credit/deferred p21 (2.86tn) + debit p22 (0.725tn) + prepaid p23 (0.012tn) ≈ 3.597tn, matching p15 (3.596tn). Internally consistent; same underlying measurement.

Two different daily card totals for 2025 (3.596tn vs 3.10tn) because of different populations (all card issuers/merchants vs 9 dedicated card firms, provisional). Not a true contradiction; must not be averaged or mixed.

assumptions.name: Online-shopping share of non-face-to-face card payments
assumptions.rationale: Non-face-to-face card payments (p27) include mobile in-store wallets, subscriptions, utility/bill payments and business purchases that are not 'online shopping' as defined by the Online Shopping Trends release, while some online shopping is settled by account transfer or cash and excluded. assumptions.falsified_by: Published 2026 online-shopping growth far outside 0-16%, or a sharp contraction in e-commerce.

assumptions.name: August seasonal index vs annual daily average

Best estimate for total online shopping transaction value in South Korea for August 2026 (all commodities, aggregate 거래액) is [[estimate]] [[unit]] ([[interval_level]] interval [[p10]] to [[p90]] [[unit]]).

The estimate scales the observed daily non-face-to-face card payment level ([[p27_value]]) to the month, then applies the online-shopping share of such payments ([[a1_value]], range [[a1_low]] to [[a1_high]]), a growth factor to 2026 ([[a2_value]], range [[a2_low]] to [[a2_high]]), and an August seasonal index ([[a3_value]], range [[a3_low]] to [[a3_high]]). Only the payment level is observed; the share, growth, and seasonality are analyst assumptions, not measured.

A single method ([[n_methods]] method, weight [[m1_weight]]) was used, so no combination evidence exists. The interval is [[interval_basis]].
